authority_citations: phase-a-intent v1 (sha256 5908af69c31e7ca46243005ac725420e801cad90b65d6c250335d3632511be8c): success - every TypeSafe API request and response sent/received through sc-agent with the minimum code needed

ANC-001 v2 locked directive: statement 'crates/sc-decision-schema must contain only the code necessary to send and receive 100% of the decision API, with nothing beyond that minimum.'; scope 'adds or changes code in crates/sc-decision-schema'; approved pass/fail fixtures

item.text: sc-decision-schema defines only the TypeSafe request, response, answer and error types plus the Backend and Decision traits; it has no transport, logging or CLI code.
item.title: sc-decision-schema contents

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-001 pass fixture: the crate is limited to decision-API types and the decision traits, which is exactly the directive.

item.text: sc-decision-schema also holds a response cache, a plan-anchor report formatter and an HTTP client.
item.title: sc-decision-schema contents

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-001 fail fixture: cache, report formatter and HTTP client are code beyond the minimum needed to send/receive the decision API; no minimality limit is stated.

item.text: Add the decision request, response and answer-option structs to crates/sc-decision-schema, mapping each one field-for-field to the TypeSafe decision API. The crate gets nothing else in this item: no client, no retries, no caching, no logging.
item.title: Add decision request and response types

cases.rationale: Changes code in the scoped crate, states the only-decision-API limit explicitly, and adds nothing beyond it.

item.text: Add the DecisionError enum and its variants to crates/sc-decision-schema, with Display implementations and doc comments.
item.title: Add decision error types

cases.rationale: Adds code to the scoped crate (error types are decision-API types, so no conflict) but never states the minimality limit the directive requires the plan to carry.

item.text: Add the Decision trait to crates/sc-decision-schema. How much code the crate should hold overall will be revisited at the sprint review.
item.title: Add the Decision trait

cases.rationale: Touches the topic of the crate's size but defers it instead of committing to the only-the-minimum limit; the Decision trait itself is permitted, so no conflict.

item.text: Add the decision request types to crates/sc-decision-schema together with a retrying reqwest HTTP client and a disk-backed response cache, so consumers need only one dependency.
item.title: One-stop decision crate

cases.rationale: Puts transport and caching code, which is beyond the minimum to send/receive the decision API, into the scoped crate; ANC-001 forbids this and INTENT puts caching out of scope.

item.text: Implement the grammar loader in crates/sc-treesitter that reads compiled grammars from the cache directory and reports missing languages.
item.title: Tree-sitter grammar loader

cases.rationale: Adds no code to crates/sc-decision-schema; outside the anchor's scope.

item.text: In crates/sc-agent-http, implement the POST call for decision requests, importing the request and response types from sc-decision-schema as they are. sc-decision-schema is not modified by this item.
item.title: HTTP POST for decisions

cases.rationale: ANC-001 scope is 'adds or changes code in crates/sc-decision-schema'; this item only depends on the crate and explicitly leaves it unmodified, so the anchor does not govern it.

item.text: Add the Decision trait to crates/sc-decision-schema and keep the crate to decision-API code, with one exception: a small in-memory response cache is added there for convenience.
item.title: Decision trait plus convenience cache

cases.rationale: ANC-001 allows no exceptions ('nothing beyond that minimum'); a carve-out for a cache does not preserve the directive and places non-minimum code in the crate.
